note: FR-160-AC-6, FR-160-AC-7 (TC-199): counter-tick covers. A reading k covers the half-open interval [k - u, k + 1 + u) for uncertainty u (ticks): lower end closed, upper end open. `within_bound` decides `ack - req <= bound`: true when the difference's upper end is at most the bound, false when its lower end exceeds the bound or equals it and is open, else indeterminate. `definitely_before` is true when every point of a is below every point of b. QSL FR-251-AC-1 (3 ms = 3000 ticks) and RT FR-276-AC-1 hold only with this half-open cover. The reader/evaluator is QSL's and RT's; QSpec's test applies the stated endpoint rule.

cases.note: ack one tick under the boundary
ack at the bound: the difference (2999, 3001) straddles it
ack one tick over: the difference (3000, 3002) is above the bound, lower end open
uncertainty 1, ack 2997: the difference upper end is 3000, open, at most the bound
uncertainty 1, ack 2998: the difference straddles the bound
uncertainty 1, ack 3003: the difference lower end is 3000, open, so above the bound
a tick is not definitely before itself
